title: The shadow
idea: Jung's shadow is the part of yourself you disown. What irritates you most in others often points to something you refuse to see in yourself.
apply: Next time someone really irritates you, ask what exactly bothers you, and where that trait shows up in you.
remind: What bothers you in others may be a part of you.
who: Ana, who cannot stand a coworker she calls arrogant.

scenes.nar: Ana cannot stand her coworker Sam. He brags about every win, interrupts in meetings, and always has an opinion.

msgs.x: The irritation is bigger than the behavior.

scenes.nar: She tells herself he is arrogant and that she would never act like that. But the irritation is stronger than his behavior deserves.
Jung would call this the shadow. Ana asks what bothers her and where it lives in her. She wants recognition too, and hides it behind modesty.

items.x: Asks for credit on her own project

scenes.nar: She starts asking for credit for her work. Sam bothers her much less, and she becomes more direct with everyone.
